QuestInfo.name: Indomitable Ice Knight
QuestInfo.0: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission. Hurry over and challenge yourself!
QuestInfo.1: Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode, she will give you a gift.\n\n#rTip! You must win as the Ice Knight in one day. If you leave the mode or one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
QuestInfo.2: You have completed the mission and received a gift.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! I am Rosette, the Battle Square guide. Right now, I am handing out gifts to those who complete challenges.
0.1: Today's mission is... You have to achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode. This mission is not that hard, but it might be hard for you to achieve. But I know you, #h0#, will going to challenge it, right?

yes.0: Don't forget! You have to achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode. If you complete the mode as challenger, then that will not be counted. Also, if you leave the mode or one day passes, your mission progress will reset, which means you can't complete the mission.

no.0: Really? It's not like it's hard...

1.0: Wow? Already? You completed the mission, Achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode. How are you feeling? It wasn't that hard, right? Alright then, I will give you a gift as I promised.

yes.0: There are other missions as well, so challenge them now!

default.0: Have you not completed the mission yet? All you need to do is achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode.

quest.0: Have you not completed the mission yet? All you need to do is achieve 1 victory with the Ice Knight in Ice Knight Mode.
